# Test fixtures

This directory holds the tiny, hand-built `.rbm` files used by the unit tests,
plus the JSON distillates of the real (client) corpora. Everything here is
committed so the test suite is self-contained and needs neither the real
database nor the inspection report PDFs.

## Files

- `synthetic_minimal.rbm` — 16 records, exercises Phase 1 (header parsing).
  Generated by `scripts/make_synthetic_fixture.py`.
- `bunge_point_names.json` — every distinct point name of the real Bunge
  Cartagena database (232 names over 5,203 points), each with the placement
  (`location` / `direction`) the rules must produce. Drives the real-corpus
  coverage tests of `point_naming` (`tests/test_point_naming.py`).
- `bunge_point_metadata_audit.json` — deterministic aggregate census derived
  from that name corpus: evidence statuses, non-emitted component/acquisition
  hints and weighted rule coverage. Regenerate or check it with
  `scripts/audit_point_metadata.py`.
- `informes_gt_findings.json` — regression corpus of the inspection-report
  DiagGT extractor: every distinct `diagnosis_text` of the 6 BUNGE 2026
  documents with the findings `informes-gt-extract 0.2.0` gave it
  (`matched_text`, `fault_mode`, `fault_group`, `label_quality`,
  `mapping_rule`). Protects the layer this package owns — the mapping — text
  by text, without the PDFs (49-73 MB each) in the repo. See
  `tests/test_informes.py`, which normalizes versioned rule ids (`GT001v2`)
  before comparing. The `0.2.0` producer label is intentionally historical:
  current deployed outputs use deterministic extractor 0.4.0 or contextual
  extractor 0.1.1, while this fixture freezes the pre-fix mapping so rule
  changes remain explicit and reviewable.

## Regenerating

After changing the synthetic schema, regenerate and commit:

```bash
uv run python scripts/make_synthetic_fixture.py
git add tests/fixtures/synthetic_minimal.rbm
```

## Why exempt these from `.gitignore`

The root `.gitignore` blocks `*.rbm` to protect the real client databases.
A negation rule (`!tests/fixtures/*.rbm`) re-allows the synthetic fixtures
in this directory only.
